title: Chaos Zero Nightmare's Half-Anniversary Merch Is Now on Sale Globally - NewsBreak
text:
By Franz Christian Irorita ,
2 hours ago
If you have been eyeing Chaos Zero Nightmare collectibles from afar, this one is for you.
Smilegate has put the dark fantasy roguelike's half-anniversary merch collection on sale through the official Smilegate Shop , and the headline detail for the game's global player base, affectionately called Protos, is that it ships worldwide.
The lineup is built around the kind of goods gacha fans tend to want on their desks. It spans acrylic stands, including holographic versions, along with an assortment of keychains, badge and pin sets, random photo cards, strap keyholders, stickers, and binder books, plus a few bundled packages for anyone who wants to grab a set at once. Availability and pricing vary by item, so the shop itself is the place to see the current stock.
The collection ties back to the game's half-anniversary, which Smilegate first celebrated earlier this year with a Korea-only cafe event, the Nightmare Garden Tea Party, in Hongdae. That was Chaos Zero Nightmare 's first offline gathering since launch, and bringing the merch to the global Smilegate Shop now opens it up to the international audience that could not make the trip.
It fits the game's growing real-world footprint, which we saw firsthand at its Anime Expo 2026 booth and its card-collecting events.
The timing is not accidental, either. The merch drop lands while Chaos Zero Nightmare is in an especially active stretch, having just rolled into its latest season of content, so the store update rides the same wave of momentum.
Anyone interested should check the Smilegate Shop for the full lineup and current pricing, and confirm that shipping reaches their region before checking out.
